claims.sentence: Elective modules are mandatory for you if you are enrolled in bachelor's, master's, or postgraduate programs
You must choose no more than one module from each block of alternatives, where each block contains at least two modules
If a module appears in multiple blocks, you may study it only once
If you do not choose an elective module by the deadline, the university assigns you to a study group for a specific module
You cannot change your elective module selection after the course begins
Facultative modules are optional for you
You may change your list of planned facultative modules or refuse to study them entirely
Any changes require approval from the university department responsible for organizing the educational process, considering the objective possibility of organizing the educational process
You cannot change your facultative module selection after the course begins
If you do not choose a facultative module by the deadline, you are exempt from studying it
The evidence does not specify the exact deadlines for choosing modules
The evidence does not define the specific criteria for "objective possibility" when approving changes to facultative modules
The evidence does not state how the university decides which module to assign you to if you fail to choose an elective module
The evidence does not detail the procedure for the intermediate certification of facultative modules beyond stating it follows local acts
The evidence does not specify the consequences of failing the intermediate certification for elective modules
The evidence does not clarify if the exemption from facultative modules affects your overall academic progress
